basis: The DESTE about page says the foundation is a non-profit institution established in Geneva in 1983 by collector Dakis Joannou.

The museum's administration page says Law 2557 of 1997 founded it as a private-law non-profit entity supervised and financed by the Ministry of Culture and Sports, with the board and the director appointed by the Minister; articles 23, 29 and 34 of the internal regulation in the Government Gazette of 1 August 2017 give the private-law staff contracts, the board's approval of the budget and the public procurement rule.
The NEON about page calls NEON a non-profit organisation founded in 2013 by collector Dimitris Daskalopoulos.
The gallery's introduction page says it is a public law entity governed by a nine-member board and that the Minister of Culture appoints the director for a five-year term.
The About page calls State of Concept Athens a non-profit contemporary art institution and an independent platform founded in 2013 by iLiana Fokianaki.
The About page names the two founders and the Supporters page refers to the space's non-profit model.

The Ministry of Culture's page on supervised bodies says MOMus was founded in 2018 as a private-law entity under the Ministry's supervision and lists Law 4572/2018 and Law 5179/2025 as its founding framework.

controls: approval of programme, loans or disposals by a ministry or council

basis: Sections 4, 5 and 7 of Inatsisartutlov nr. 8 of 3 June 2015 (marked in force) say the Self-Government establishes and runs the museum, Naalakkersuisut employs its director and approves its annual report and any disposal of objects, and page 6 of the 2024 annual report states its operating grant comes from the Finance Act.

The Hvem er vi page calls Katuaq an independent commercial foundation (selvejende institution) whose founders and main grant givers are Naalakkersuisut and Kommuneqarfik Sermersooq, and page 6 of the 2023 management report lists a board with members appointed by both.

The museum's About page says the gift of the museum was handed to the municipality Kommuneqarfik Sermersooq, which runs it, and its residency page says the museum is owned by Kommuneqarfik Sermersooq.
